name: 12-Sabat II JI Well Temperament
description: 12-tone Rational Intonation Well Temperament, derived from harmonic partial row intervals limited to the prime subgroup of 2, 3, 5, and 17, 19. Seven diatonic notes and F are tuned Pythagorean, allowing the historical Persian Arabic schisma tunings to be applied. A and D are added as major thirds, and the two remaining tones are divided evenly using 16:17.
